title: Fed Governor Waller says a half-point rate hike may be needed in December
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said Wednesday that the central bank may need to raise its benchmark interest rate by half a percentage point at the Dec. 8-9 policy meeting to "shock people" and bring down inflation, which he said is running higher than he expected. Waller, speaking to CNBC, also said the Fed should reverse the three quarter-point cuts it made in 2025 and may need to raise rates further beyond that.
